title: Elizabeth Holmes sheds single tear in 1st full trailer for Nathan Fielder doc
summary: If the teaser for You Can See Everything made you feel uncomfortable, the two-minute, 20-second trailer won't do anything to ease your distress. The documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim…

image.caption: You Can See Everything is a documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim that follows Theranos founder and convicted fraudster Elizabeth Holmes, pictured above, in the 34 days before she began serving her 11-year prison sentence. (A24)

blocks.text: Entertainment·New

If the teaser for You Can See Everything made you feel uncomfortable, the two-minute, 20-second trailer won't do anything to ease your distress. The documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim was filmed in the 34 days before Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes went to prison to serve an 11-year sentence for defrauding business investors.
You can't see everything, but you can see more of the disquieting new doc
If the teaser trailer for You Can See Everything made you feel awkward and uncomfortable, the two-minute, 20-second version won't do anything to ease your distress.

The documentary by Canadian filmmaker Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim was filmed in the 34 days before Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes went to prison to serve an 11-year sentence for defrauding business investors.

The film crew, and Fielder in particular, is openly skeptical, posing challenging questions as Holmes insists she has nothing to hide, maintaining her innocence — and even shedding a single tear as she stares earnestly into the interviewer's eyes.
"What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending, three-year journey into the abyss," said production company A24 in its logline for the film.
Details relationship with husband

The full-length trailer also gives viewers a glimpse of Holmes's relationship with her husband Billy Evans, who comes from a family of successful hoteliers. The pair met back in 2017, as Theranos was collapsing.

In 2014, Holmes became the youngest self-made female billionaire in the U.S., according to Forbes, by claiming she had developed a technology that could cheaply screen for hundreds of diseases using just a few drops of blood from a finger prick.
The following year, the first federal criminal charges were filed against her.

items: Theranos closing labs, laying off 340 following sanctions
Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes begins 11-year prison term

blocks.text: In the documentary, Fielder, who is known for his satirical show Nathan for You, is seen questioning Evans about his relationship with Holmes.
"Weren't you worried she was sort of scamming you?" Fielder asks.
"100 per cent, but what did she have to gain from me?" Evans replies.
"Well, isn't your family rich?"
"Yeah, I think that there's a lot of different levels of wealth."
Holmes had 1st child in 2021
Holmes and Evans had their first child in August 2021, mere months before she was convicted of wire fraud and conspiracy to commit fraud.
She revealed she was pregnant with her second child shortly after she was sentenced to more than 11 years in prison.
Elizabeth Holmes reports to prison
"You've never been suspicious that she's ever lied to you?" an incredulous Fielder again asks Evans.
"No, never," he responds.
You Can See Everything comes to theatres Oct. 16.
